queries.name: raw_work_rows
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(id) AS unique_ids FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet)

queries.name: raw_bridge_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS a WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id) IS NOT NULL) AS authors, (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(openalex_numeric_id(id), openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id), openalex_numeric_id(i.id))) FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS a ARRAY JOIN a.institutions AS i WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(i.id) IS NOT NULL) AS institutions, (SELECT count() FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN topics AS t WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(t.id) IS NOT NULL AND t.score IS NOT NULL) AS topics

queries.name: materialized_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.works) AS works, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author) AS authors, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution) AS institutions, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_topic) AS topics, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.citation_edge) AS citations

queries.name: referential_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.works w ON wa.work_id=w.work_id) AS missing_works_for_authors, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author) AS author_bridge_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id) AS missing_authors, (SELECT uniqExact(wa.author_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id) AS distinct_missing_author_ids, (SELECT uniqExact(wa.work_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id) AS works_with_missing_authors, if(author_bridge_rows = 0, 1., 1 - missing_authors / author_bridge_rows) AS author_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author WHERE author_id=9999999999) AS null_author_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author WHERE author_id=5317838346) AS deleted_author_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author WHERE author_id NOT IN (9999999999,5317838346)) AS ordinary_authorship_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id WHERE wa.author_id NOT IN (9999999999,5317838346)) AS ordinary_missing_author_rows, (SELECT uniqExact(wa.author_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id WHERE wa.author_id NOT IN (9999999999,5317838346)) AS distinct_ordinary_missing_author_ids, (SELECT uniqExact(wa.work_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id WHERE wa.author_id NOT IN (9999999999,5317838346)) AS works_with_ordinary_missing_authors, if(ordinary_authorship_rows = 0, 1., 1 - ordinary_missing_author_rows / ordinary_authorship_rows) AS ordinary_author_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution) AS institution_bridge_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS missing_institutions, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.institution_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS distinct_missing_institution_ids, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.work_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS works_with_missing_institutions, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.author_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS authors_with_missing_institutions, if(institution_bridge_rows = 0, 1., (institution_bridge_rows - missing_institutions) / institution_bridge_rows) AS institution_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_topic) AS topic_bridge_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_topic wt LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.topics t ON wt.topic_id=t.topic_id) AS missing_topics, (SELECT uniqExact(wt.topic_id) FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_topic wt LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.topics t ON wt.topic_id=t.topic_id) AS distinct_missing_topic_ids, if(topic_bridge_rows = 0, 1., (topic_bridge_rows - missing_topics) / topic_bridge_rows) AS topic_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.citation_edge) AS citation_edges, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.citation_edge ce INNER JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.works w ON ce.cited_work_id=w.work_id) AS retained_cited_edges, if(citation_edges = 0, 1., retained_cited_edges / citation_edges) AS citation_retention_ratio

queries.name: missing_author_sample
queries.sql: WITH missing_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT wa.author_id FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id) SELECT openalex_numeric_id(authorship.author.id) AS author_id, multiIf(author_id=9999999999, 'null_author', author_id=5317838346, 'deleted_author', 'ordinary') AS classification, arraySlice(arraySort(groupUniqArray(ifNull(authorship.author.display_name, ''))), 1, 5) AS display_names, count() AS raw_bridge_rows FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS authorship WHERE openalex_numeric_id(authorship.author.id) IN missing_ids GROUP BY author_id ORDER BY raw_bridge_rows DESC, author_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: missing_institution_sample
queries.sql: WITH missing_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT wi.institution_id FROM openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage2_stage2_repeat_medium_18c_900581fe.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) SELECT openalex_numeric_id(raw_institution.id) AS institution_id, any(raw_institution.display_name) AS display_name, count() AS raw_bridge_rows FROM file('tiers/stage2_medium/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS authorship ARRAY JOIN authorship.institutions AS raw_institution WHERE openalex_numeric_id(raw_institution.id) IN missing_ids GROUP BY institution_id ORDER BY raw_bridge_rows DESC, institution_id LIMIT 25
